newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Blue Star amends Wang NZ put/call option.
newsitem.headline: Blue Star amends Wang NZ put/call option.

text.p: Blue Star on Tuesday said it proposed to amend the pricing of a put/call option over the remaining 1.7 million Wang NZ shares held by Wang Laboratories Inc.
Blue Star is now proposing an agreement be reached with Wang Laboratories on the appointment of an independent expert to value the remaining shares and to prepare a valuation report.
The report would set the pricing of any put or call option and the valuation would be used in compulsory acquisition.
Blue Star would then settle its obligations in regard to any put/call option "as soon as applicable".
Blue Star, a unit of U.S. Office Products already has more than 97.7 percent of Wang NZ, a former unit of Wang Laboratories.
